definitions.gloss: sold separately; available as a separate purchase
definitions.explanation: Indicates that an item is not included with the main product and must be purchased independently.

examples.japanese: カバーは{別売|べつう}りです。
{電池|でんち}は{別売|べつう}りなので{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please note that batteries are sold separately.

examples.japanese: {専用|せんよう}の{充電器|じゅうでんき}は{別売|べつう}りで{三千円|さんぜんえん}する。
examples.english: The dedicated charger is sold separately and costs 3,000 yen.

notes:
Compound of {別|べつ} (separate) + {売|う}り (selling). Very common in product descriptions, packaging, and online shopping. Often appears as a note or disclaimer.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {別売|べつう}りです (is sold separately)
- {別売|べつう}りの〜 (separately sold ~)
- {別売|べつう}り{品|ひん} (separately sold item)
- {別売|べつう}りで{購入|こうにゅう}する (to purchase separately)

TYPICAL ITEMS MARKED {別売|べつう}り:
- {電池|でんち} (batteries)
- {充電器|じゅうでんき} (charger)
- ケース / カバー (case / cover)
- {付属品|ふぞくひん} (accessories)

CONTRAST:
- {付属|ふぞく}: included, bundled (opposite concept)
- {同梱|どうこん}: packaged together
- セット{販売|はんばい}: sold as a set
